SELECT ua.id, ua.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.phone, u.nickname, ua.balance, ua.frozen_amount AS frozenAmount, ua.total_income AS totalIncome, ua.total_expense AS totalExpense, ua.created_at AS createdAt, ua.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tb_jmz_user_accounts ua LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_user u ON ua.user_id = u.user_id
AND ua.user_id = #{userId}
AND u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
ORDER BY ua.created_at DESC
